ONS Local Planning Authorities (December 2024) Names and Codes in the UK exposes LPA24CD, LPA24NM and Co-terminous fields and provides an official GeoJSON data link, materially extending the prior lookup-only method toward identifier plus geometry-capable evidence. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative LPA24CD/LPA24NM, LAD code/name, local-plan-boundary reference, organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Selecting any LPA feature would therefore be guessing. No coverage-area feature is emitted because coverage_area_id and exact slot binding cannot be established. No parcel record accepted and no Plan0 package emitted.
